snippet_primary: "Gumroad reviews are not sorted by most recent. It is positive reviews first with no way to see negative reviews for a popular product except clicking and clicking and clicking. This is what I meant about a fairly dodge platform. Sahil Lavingia has set up Gumroad to make it very difficult for potential buyers to even see negative reviews."
